What these replace
Play split menu: one accent control, 12 px chevron, always Add to queue · Play next · Start radio (D2).
Filter flyout B: replaces the long collapsible form; the count in the header and the badge on the button follow every change at once (D5).
Sort: one label and one chevron in the bar; direction is a radio group in the menu; the button is lit only off the page default (D6).
Row size, Select and Columns live in the list ⋯ (D3); Row size writes the Classic density option.
